comparison.objective: Push a shower cartridge through O-ring resistance and install its U-clip; candidate removes a terminal by releasing its locking tab.
comparison.physical_skill: Axial force control while holding a cartridge seated and sliding a retainer past ears versus blade insertion beneath a tab and coupled extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Cartridge flush and retainer fully seated after release versus terminal fully removed without housing, crimp or neighbor damage. Candidate numeric force/damage limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Both concern retainers, but one tests forceful assembly under O-ring preload and the other selective depinning.
